description:
Remove iMessage contact profile picture

Removes the custom profile picture and keeps the names when expectedVersion matches. An identical configuration keeps its version after verification. Returns 200 after confirmation and commit, 202 while pending, or a problem on failure. Repeat the same request with the same Idempotency-Key after Retry-After to await the result. Results are retained for 24 hours; key replay precedes version validation. A different change while one is pending returns 409. Requires platforms:write bound to the path project.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/imessage/remove-imessage-contact-profile-picture
name: removeImessageContactProfilePicture

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description: Known values: ["project","custom","none"]. Others may be added.
